effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Monzaemon] in its name from among them to your hand, and play 1 Digimon card with [Numemon] in its name from among them without paying its cost. Return the rest to the bottom of your deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
